e.title: Ballast 链上参数化下跌保障：明说「它卖的是参数化保险，不是对冲」，并自己列出两侧都赔不准的基差风险表；界面永远显示**实际达成**的保本点，而不是你要求的那个
e.title_en: Ballast, on-chain parametric downside cover: it states plainly that it sells parametric cover rather than a hedge, publishes its own basis-risk table showing it over- and under-compensates on either side, and its interface always shows the make-whole point actually achieved rather than the one requested
e.title_hk: Ballast 鏈上參數化下跌保障：明說「它賣的是參數化保險，不是對沖」，並自己列出兩側都賠不準的基差風險表；界面永遠顯示**實際達成**的保本點，而不是你要求的那個
e.summary: 一个在链上自动为加密资产买入下行保障的产品：用户存入一次抵押品并说出想覆盖多深的跌幅，之后每个交易窗口自动买入一份固定赔付款；其技术要点是「场所自身的事件就是触发器」——市场创建事件一触发，其处理函数在同一个区块内运行，因此产品不需要任何运营方、定时任务或自建守护进程；文档最值得记的是它对自身性质的界定：事件合约是每窗口一个执行价的平值二元合约，因此**没有任何数量的下行合约能拼出一条平直的净损益线**，它明确不主张这一点，而是把自己称为参数化保障，并逐格列出跌幅 1%／2.5%／5% 三种情形下现货损失、保障赔付与净额的对照（+75 过度补偿／0 保本点／−125 补偿不足）；它把两侧的差额称为基差风险，并说这不是要工程掉的缺陷而是你买到的东西；因此界面上永远显示**实际达成**的保本点而不是你要求的那个；仓库另有一份给平台方的反馈文档与一份运行记录
e.summary_hk: 一個在鏈上自動為加密資產買入下行保障的產品：用戶存入一次抵押品並說出想覆蓋多深的跌幅，之後每個交易窗口自動買入一份固定賠付款；其技術要點是「場所自身的事件就是觸發器」——市場創建事件一觸發，其處理函數在同一個區塊內運行，因此產品不需要任何運營方、定時任務或自建守護進程；文檔最值得記的是它對自身性質的界定：事件合約是每窗口一個執行價的平值二元合約，因此**沒有任何數量的下行合約能拼出一條平直的淨損益線**，它明確不主張這一點，而是把自己稱為參數化保障，並逐格列出跌幅 1%／2.5%／5% 三種情形下現貨損失、保障賠付與淨額的對照（+75 過度補償／0 保本點／−125 補償不足）；它把兩側的差額稱為基差風險，並說這不是要工程掉的缺陷而是你買到的東西；因此界面上永遠顯示**實際達成**的保本點而不是你要求的那個；倉庫另有一份給平台方的反饋文檔與一份運行記錄
e.summary_en: A product that automatically buys downside cover for crypto on-chain: a user deposits collateral once and states how deep a fall to cover, and thereafter each trading window automatically buys a fixed payout; its technical point is that the venue’s own event is the trigger — when the market-creation event fires its handler runs in the same block, so the product needs no operator, no cron and nothing of its own running; the most notable part of its documentation is how it defines its own nature: Event Contracts are at-the-money binaries with one strike per window, so no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and it explicitly does not claim one — instead it calls itself parametric cover and lays out a table of spot loss, cover paid and net for falls of 1%, 2.5% and 5% (+75 over-compensated, 0 at the make-whole point, −125 under-compensated); it calls the gap either side basis risk and says it is not a defect to be engineered away but what you are buying; consequently its interface always shows the make-whole point actually achieved rather than the one requested; and the repository also carries a feedback document to the platform and a run record
e.body:
**ballast-parametric-cover**（Ballast，仓库 `Jagadeeshftw/ballast`）**是一个在链上自动为加密资产买入下行保障的产品**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 实测存在）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 1,714 KB、创建于 2026-09-01、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**topics 实测为** `defi`、`dreamdex`、`event-contracts`、`foundry`、`parametric-insurance`、`prediction-markets`、`reactivity`、`solidity`、`somnia`；**README 实测 20,374 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 192 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Ballast buys downside cover for your crypto automatically — a small, fixed payout that lands if the price falls, bought fresh every trading window.** You deposit collateral once and say how deep a fall you want covered; **the chain does the rest, with no keeper, no cron and nothing of ours running.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「只报别人能重算的数」**中的**第二种，也是四条里唯一**把「我到底卖的是什么」以及**它的误差范围**同时公开**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其最值得记的一节标题本身就是一句拒绝模糊化的话**——**逐字为**：**「## It sells parametric cover, not a hedge — **This distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「这个区别就是整个产品，而 README 不会把它模糊掉」**——**⭐ 这句话在结构上与本轮主题相合：**它拒绝用一个更好听的名字（对冲）来掩盖自己实际交付的东西（参数化保障）****。**其理由逐字给出，且理由本身是一条**可核实的市场结构事实****：**「Event Contracts are **at-the-money binaries**: one strike per window, struck at the window’s opening price, paying a fixed 1 collateral unit per winning contract. **There is no strike ladder — 562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window.** So **no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and Ballast does not claim one.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① 「**562 个市场逐一看过，每个场所每个窗口至多一个执行价**」**——**即**这不是推测，而是**数出来的**（**⭐ 与第 337 轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 的「12 个地点、24 次调用」同属**先测后说**）；**② **没有执行价阶梯**，**故**没有任何数量的下行合约能拼出一条平直的净损益线**；**③ 「**and Ballast does not claim one**」**——**即**它不去主张一个自己做不到的性质****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其基差风险表是本条最值得借用的一处：它把自己**赔不准的地方**逐格列出来**——**逐字为**：**「| ETH falls | Spot loss | Cover pays | Net |」**：**1% | −$50 | +$125 | **+$75 — over-compensated**」**；**「2.5% | −$125 | +$125 | **$0 — the make-whole point**」**；**「5% | −$250 | +$125 | **−$125 — under-compensated**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三行各说一件事**：**跌得浅**过度补偿**、**在保本点上**刚好抵消**、**跌得深**补偿不足****——**⭐ 对做产品的同学，这是一张**把「我什么时候帮不上忙」摆在最前面**的表**（**本站在第 330／331 轮已记录过「把假设与检验边界写成明文」的同族做法，而**这张表的不同之处在于它会计量的是**结果对客户的偏差****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它对「基差风险」这一定性的表述逐字，且明确说这不是要工程掉的东西**——**逐字为**：**「The gap either side is **basis risk**, and it is **the defining property of parametric cover** — the same trade flight-delay insurance makes, paying the same amount whether you missed a meeting or a wedding. **It is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are buying.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「这不是一个要在这里被工程掉的缺陷；它就是你所购买的东西」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条对保险读者最有价值的一句**：**它把一个通常被当作**缺点**来解释的性质，明确改述为一个**产品定义****；**并**用「航班延误险不管你是错过会议还是错过婚礼、赔的金额一样」作类比**——**⭐ 对读精算的同学，这正是**参数化（指数）保险与传统 indemnity 保险的核心分野****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该类比在法律或监管意义上成立**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其界面的一处设计决定是本条的**核心机制**，且它与本轮的**「只报能重算的数」**直接相扣**——**逐字为**：**「which is why **the UI always shows the make-whole point it *achieved*, never the one you asked for, whenever liquidity bound the size**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**当流动性限制了规模时，界面显示的是**实际达成**的保本点，**而不是用户要求的那个****——**⭐ 这与第 337 轮 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的「被机器人拦截的外部结果不算作已确认的死链」、第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「校准斜率带事先声明的治理带」属同一族纪律：**交付的是**实际值**，不是**目标值****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**其界面确实如此**——**见标注 ④**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其规模公式逐字公开，且含一个**读回来的实际值**——**逐字为**：**「Sizing: `N = exposure × x* / (1 − q)`, premium `N·q`, and **the achieved point read back as `qty·(1−q)·10000 / exposureAtOpen`**.」**⭐⭐ **即**名义规模与前缀保费各有公式，而「实际达成的保本点」是**从成交结果反算回来的**，而不是把用户输入原样回显****（**⭐ 这是第 ④ 点在数学层面的落实**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其技术要点「场所自身的事件就是触发器」逐字，且它给出的是**为什么这个产品不需要运营方**的理由**——**逐字为**：**「the venue’s own event is the trigger. **`MarketCreated` fires, and Ballast’s handler runs in the same block**, so **the product needs no operator at all**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**处理函数与市场创建事件**在同一个区块内**运行**，**故**不需要守护进程、定时任务或人工操作****——**⭐ 对做保险自动化的同学，这是一条**把「自动」建立在平台原生事件上**的路径**（**可与第 337 轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 的「GitHub 的 cron 是尽力而为、实际每 2–5 小时而非 15 分钟」并读：**两者都在处理**「谁来定时触发」**这一层**——**一个靠平台事件、一个靠尽力而为的调度器****）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其「为什么一个对冲产品会出现在预测市场黑客松」一节把**类别归属**也讲明了**——**逐字为**：**「**None of the published categories is risk management, so the frame is worth stating outright.**」**；**以及** **「Almost everything built on such a primitive is a way to *take* a view. **Ballast is the opposite — it is a consumer of the primitive that is not a bet.**」**⭐⭐ **即**它先承认公开的赛道里没有风险管理这一类，**再把理由写出来**（**⭐ 而「它是该原语的消费者，且不是一次下注」是它对自己性质的第二次界定**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其链上部署与文档结构实测可查**：**README 逐字列出五个合约地址**（**BallastVault、HedgeEngine、SpotExposureSource、Collateral（tUSDC，6 位小数）、dreamDEX 二元模块**）**，**并给出链 ID 与 RPC**；**实测仓库含 `foundry.toml` 与 `foundry.lock`、`package.json`、`assets/ballast_logo.png`，以及 `docs/` 下十份文档**——**逐名为** `go-live.md`、`instrument-economics.md`、`latch-sweep.md`、`onchain-lifecycle.md`、`phase0-dashboard.md`、**`phase0-findings.md`**、**`run-record.json`**、**`somnia-feedback.md`**、`tailwind-migration-estimate.md`、`video-script.md`**⭐⭐ **其中三份值得单独记**：**① **`instrument-economics.md`**（**工具本身的定价与经济性**）；**② **`phase0-findings.md`**（**第 0 阶段的发现**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **`somnia-feedback.md`**——**即**给平台方的一份反馈文档****（**⭐ 与第 337 轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 把调度问题归因到平台同属一种做法：**把问题交回给上游，而不是自己吞下****）；**另有 **`run-record.json`****（**一份运行记录**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站参数化险、巨灾与相关条目并读**：[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[amanat-telegraph-miner]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本条目需要先说清一件事：**这不是一份保险合同****——**⚠️ 它运行在测试网上，**topics 里含 `defi`／`prediction-markets`／`event-contracts`**，**其标的是**加密资产的价格**；**⭐ 本词条收录它的理由**是**它把**参数化保障的基差风险**写得比本站已收的多数条目更清楚**（**Basis risk 正是参数化／指数保险的核心概念**），**⚠️ 而**不主张**它是一个保险产品、受任何保险监管、或可用于任何真实的风险转移**；**⚠️ 亦**不主张**其做法适用于传统险种**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次只读了 README 的**开篇、链上地址表、「为什么一个对冲产品会出现在预测市场黑客松」、「它卖的是参数化保障，不是对冲」与规模公式各节****——**⚠️ 即**本次**未通读其 20,374 字节的全文**，**也未读 `docs/` 下十份文档中**任何一份的内容****；**故**本词条所述内容限于上述各节**（**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其任何数字**——**包括「562 个市场逐一看过、每个场所每窗口至多一个执行价」、基差表中的 −$50／+$125／+$75／$0／−$250／−$125、以及规模公式的各次计算**；**⚠️ 本次**未克隆、未安装 Foundry 或 Node、未运行任何测试、未访问任何区块浏览器或链上数据****。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**「界面永远显示实际达成的保本点而不是用户要求的那个」这一设计**（**⚠️ 本次**未访问其站点或仪表盘 `ballast.0xo.in`／`/app`、未读任何前端代码**）；**⭐ 这是本条目第二处需要后续核实的地方**（**因为它正是本条对本轮主题的核心贡献**）。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**五个合约地址是否确实部署、是否可读、以及 `HedgeEngine` 是否确如标注为「live」**（**本次未访问 Shannon 浏览器**）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其「处理函数与 `MarketCreated` 在同一区块内运行」这一技术主张**——**⚠️ 这是一个**平台级**的性质**（**依赖该链的 reactivity 机制**），**⚠️ 本次**未读其合约或平台文档、未做任何链上核实**；**⭐ 本词条**不主张**该「同区块」性质在该链上确实成立**。**⑦ ⚠️ **未核实**其 `docs/somnia-feedback.md` 的内容与对象**（**只核实该文件存在**）；**亦**未核实**其是否真的向平台提交过反馈**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README 的上述各节、以及仓库全部 192 个条目的文件清单**；**⭐ 其中 `docs/` 下十份文档、`foundry.toml`／`foundry.lock`、`package.json`、`assets/` 均经 tarball 实测**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Foundry 或 Node、未运行任何测试或脚本、未做任何链上请求、**未读任何合约源码、未读任何一份 `docs/` 文档的内容、未访问其站点或仪表盘或任何区块浏览器**。**⑨ ⚠️ **未核实**其与 Somnia／dreamDEX 或任何黑客松主办方的关系**，**亦**未核实**其是否获奖、是否被采用、或是否有任何真实资金参与**；**本词条**不主张**该产品已上线运营、已产生任何赔付或已被任何人使用**。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其所引「航班延误险赔付时不问你是错过会议还是错过婚礼」这一类比在保险实务或条款上的准确性**——**本次未查任何航班延误险条款**；**本词条只记录它如此陈述**。**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其参数化保障的定价（`N = exposure × x* / (1 − q)` 等）在精算上充分或正确**——**⚠️ 其公式中的 `q` 与 `x*` 的确定方式本次未核实**（**未读 `docs/instrument-economics.md`**）。**⑫ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-01、推送于 2026-09-10**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑬ **README 为英语**——**本词条已如实记入，**本次未核实是否有其他语言版本**；**⑭ ⭐ 许可实测为 **MIT** 且 `LICENSE` 实测存在**——**⭐ 与本轮其他三条对照：**[[amanat-telegraph-miner]] 同为 MIT，而 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 与 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 实测**无许可文件****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Jagadeeshftw/ballast` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段 MIT、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 9 个 topics）；README 20,374 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测读取上述各节；**仓库全部 192 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对；**未克隆、未安装 Foundry 或 Node、未运行任何测试、未做任何链上请求、未读任何合约源码或 `docs/` 文档内容、未访问其站点或仪表盘或任何区块浏览器**。

**ballast-parametric-cover**（Ballast，倉庫 `Jagadeeshftw/ballast`）**是一個在鏈上自動為加密資產買入下行保障的產品**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 實測存在）、主語言 TypeScript、體量 1,714 KB、創建於 2026-09-01、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**topics 實測 9 個**（含 `defi`、`event-contracts`、`parametric-insurance`、`prediction-markets`、`reactivity`、`somnia`）；**README 實測 20,374 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 192 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Ballast buys downside cover for your crypto automatically … the chain does the rest, with no keeper, no cron and nothing of ours running.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「只報別人能重算的數」**中的**第二種，也是四條裡唯一**把「我到底賣的是什麼」以及**它的誤差範圍**同時公開**的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其最值得記的一節標題本身就是一句拒絕模糊化的話**——**逐字為**：**「## It sells parametric cover, not a hedge — **This distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「這個區別就是整個產品，而 README 不會把它模糊掉」**——**⭐ 在結構上與本輪主題相合：**它拒絕用一個更好聽的名字（對沖）來掩蓋自己實際交付的東西（參數化保障）****。**其理由逐字給出，且理由本身是一條**可核實的市場結構事實****：**「Event Contracts are **at-the-money binaries**: one strike per window … **There is no strike ladder — 562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window.** So **no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and Ballast does not claim one.**」**⭐⭐⭐ are buying.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「這不是一個要在這裡被工程掉的缺陷；它就是你所購買的東西」**——**⭐ 本條對保險讀者最有價值的一句**：**它把一個通常被當作**缺點**來解釋的性質，明確改述為一個**產品定義****；**並**用航班延誤險作類比**——**⭐ 這正是**參數化（指數）保險與傳統 indemnity 保險的核心分野****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **ballast-parametric-cover** (Ballast, repository `Jagadeeshftw/ballast`) **is a product that automatically buys downside cover for crypto on-chain**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **MIT** (`LICENSE` measured present), TypeScript as the primary language, a 1,714 KB repository, created 2026-09-01 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **9 topics measured**, including `defi`, `event-contracts`, `parametric-insurance`, `prediction-markets`, `reactivity` and `somnia`; **the README measures 20,374 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 192 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"**Ballast buys downside cover for your crypto automatically … the chain does the rest, with no keeper, no cron and nothing of ours running.**"** It is the second of this round’s four takes on **reporting only numbers someone else can recompute**, **and the only one that publishes both what it actually sells and the size of its own error**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **The heading of its most notable section is itself a refusal to blur** — **verbatim**: **"## It sells parametric cover, not a hedge — **This distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"this distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it"** — ⭐ **structurally aligned with this round’s theme: it refuses to let a better-sounding name (a hedge) conceal what it actually delivers (parametric cover)**. **The reason is given verbatim and is itself a checkable market-structure fact**: **"Event Contracts are **at-the-money binaries**: one strike per window … **There is no strike ladder — 562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window.** So **no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and Ballast does not claim one.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things worth noting**: **"562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window" is counted rather than assumed**; **with no strike ladder, no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line**; **and "Ballast does not claim one" — it does not assert a property it cannot deliver**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its basis-risk table lays out cell by cell where it compensates wrongly** — **verbatim**: **ETH falls 1% | spot loss −$50 | cover pays +$125 | net **+$75, over-compensated**; 2.5% | −$125 | +$125 | **$0, the make-whole point**; 5% | −$250 | +$125 | **−$125, under-compensated**** ⭐⭐⭐ **three rows saying three things: shallow falls are over-compensated, the make-whole point cancels exactly, deep falls are under-compensated** — ⭐ **for students of product design, a table that puts "when I cannot help" first**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its characterisation of basis risk is verbatim and says outright that it is not to be engineered away**: **"The gap either side is **basis risk**, and it is **the defining property of parametric cover** — the same trade flight-delay insurance makes, paying the same amount whether you missed a meeting or a wedding. **It is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are buying.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"it is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are buying"** — ⭐ **the most valuable sentence here for an insurance reader: a property usually explained as a shortcoming is restated explicitly as the product definition**, **using the flight-delay analogy** — ⭐ **which is exactly the core distinction between parametric (index) insurance and traditional indemnity insurance**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ One interface decision is the entry’s central mechanism** — **verbatim**: **"which is why **the UI always shows the make-whole point it *achieved*, never the one you asked for, whenever liquidity bound the size**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **when liquidity constrained the size, the interface shows the make-whole point actually achieved rather than the one requested** — ⭐ **the same family as round 337’s [[insurance-qa-evidence]] ("externally bot-blocked results are not classified as confirmed dead links") and round 336’s [[inforsight]] (a pre-declared governance band for the calibration slope): what is delivered is the actual value, not the target value**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its sizing formulas are published verbatim and include a value read back** : **"Sizing: `N = exposure × x* / (1 − q)`, premium `N·q`, and **the achieved point read back as `qty·(1−q)·10000 / exposureAtOpen`**."** ⭐⭐ **the achieved point is recomputed from the filled result rather than echoed from user input**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Its technical point that the venue’s own event is the trigger is verbatim**: **"the venue’s own event is the trigger. **`MarketCreated` fires, and Ballast’s handler runs in the same block**, so **the product needs no operator at all**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **the handler runs in the same block as the market-creation event, so no keeper daemon, cron job or human operator is needed** (**readable with round 337’s [[storm-parametric-corroboration]], where GitHub’s cron is best-effort and observed at every 2 to 5 hours rather than every 15 minutes: both are dealing with who triggers on schedule — one via a platform event, one via a best-effort scheduler**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its "why a hedging product is in a prediction-market hackathon" section also states the category problem**: **"**None of the published categories is risk management, so the frame is worth stating outright.**"**; **"Almost everything built on such a primitive is a way to *take* a view. **Ballast is the opposite — it is a consumer of the primitive that is not a bet.**"** ⭐⭐ **it concedes first that no published track covers risk management, then gives its reason for being there**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its on-chain deployment and document structure are measurable**: **the README lists five contract addresses verbatim** (**BallastVault, HedgeEngine, SpotExposureSource, Collateral (tUSDC, 6dp) and the dreamDEX binary module**) **with the chain ID and RPC**; **the repository measurably contains `foundry.toml`, `foundry.lock`, `package.json`, `assets/ballast_logo.png` and ten documents under `docs/`** — namely `go-live.md`, `instrument-economics.md`, `latch-sweep.md`, `onchain-lifecycle.md`, `phase0-dashboard.md`, **`phase0-findings.md`**, **`run-record.json`**, **`somnia-feedback.md`**, `tailwind-migration-estimate.md` and `video-script.md` ⭐⭐ **three of which deserve separate note**: **`instrument-economics.md` (the instrument’s own pricing and economics)**, **`phase0-findings.md` (phase-0 findings)**, **and ⭐⭐ `somnia-feedback.md` — a feedback document to the platform** — ⭐ **the same move as round 337’s [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] attributing its scheduling gap to the platform: hand the problem back upstream rather than absorbing it**; **plus `run-record.json`, a run record**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s parametric, catastrophe and related entries**: [[storm-parametric-corroboration]], [[amanat-telegraph-miner]], [[parametric-risk-toolkit]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]], [[aegis-parametric]], [[condition-parametric-zk]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] and [[cat-bond-pricing]].

⭐ **the entry includes it because it sets out parametric cover’s basis risk more clearly than most entries the site already holds** (**basis risk being a core concept of parametric and index insurance**), **⚠️ but it does not claim this is an insurance product, is subject to insurance regulation, or is usable for any real risk transfer**. **② ⚠️⚠️ Only the README’s opening, its on-chain address table, "why a hedging product is in a prediction-market hackathon", "it sells parametric cover, not a hedge" and the sizing formulas were read** — **⚠️ its full 20,374 bytes were not read through, and none of the ten documents under `docs/` was read**;
